summary: Andrea Kimi Antonelli arrives at Las Vegas with a commanding 111-point lead at the top of the drivers' championship, but a qualifying penalty hands pole position to Max Verstappen as Mercedes seeks to clinch the constructors' title. The simmering Verstappen-Russell rivalry ignites again on the front row, with George Russell primed to challenge after topping practice on the wet track. A victory for Antonelli or further Mercedes dominance would move the team closer to sealing the constructors' championship with two races remaining.
